description: Funding rate, open interest and positioning for Binance USDⓈ-M perpetual futures — the derivatives questions candles cannot answer: is funding high (who is paying whom, annualized), is open interest building or unwinding (24h/4h change, and the OI×price regime: new longs, short covering, new shorts, long liquidation), and which way accounts lean (top-trader long/short by position, all-account ratio, taker buy/sell flow). Each symbol carries plain-language notes — quote those. Up to 5 symbols per call; data is 60s fresh.

symbols.description: Up to 5 Binance USDⓈ-M futures symbols, e.g. ["BTCUSDT", "ETHUSDT"]. A bare base asset ("BTC") is read as its USDT perpetual.

name: get_derivatives

data.description: One entry per symbol: { symbol, markPrice, indexPrice, premiumPct, funding { rate, ratePct, annualizedPct, nextFundingTime, minutesToNextFunding, avg24hPct, avg3dPct, label }, openInterest { contracts, valueUsd, change4hPct, change24hPct, priceChange24hPct, regime }, positioning { globalLongShortRatio, globalLongPct, topTraderLongShortRatio, topTraderLongPct, takerBuySellRatio, label }, notes[] } — or { symbol, error, message } when the symbol is not a Binance USDⓈ-M futures pair
